Dropped from § 2: Cisco Unity Connection CVE-2026-20034/20035 (8.8/7.2 don't clear gates; logged § 7). Dropped from § 3 per PD-11: TCLBANKER (off-audience), CallPhantom (off-audience). Held: Laclinic-Montreux/Qilin (single dark-web aggregator, no victim statement). Phase 4.5 verification: 2 iterations. Iteration 1 truth=6/editorial=4/advisory=5; remediations applied (wrong Elastic URL, wrong CIS advisory URL, blocked CISA news-events URL, unsourced superlative, CVE patch version clarification, vendor-list softening, Fribourg canton add, JDownloader RAT description softening, Groupe 3R 2025 incident framing, Canvas figure de-precision). Iteration 2 truth=4/editorial=3/advisory=3; remediations applied (companion CVE inventory completed, superlative removed from § 4 body, IOC false-positive context word added). NCSC-CH Security Hub URLs use API endpoint format (/api/posts/NNN/details) per 2026-05-09 convention to bypass SPA-hash-fragment checker false-positive. Sub-agent self-id drift: all four S* wrote 'Claude Sonnet 4.5' as friendly name with model id `claude-sonnet-4-6`; verifier iteration 2 self-id'd as 'Claude Sonnet 4.6' (correct). Documented in § 7.
